learning_outcomes.text: Explain the photovoltaic effect and the main PV cell and module technologies
Describe the components of a grid-tied and an off-grid PV system
Estimate the energy yield of a PV array from irradiance, orientation and losses
Interpret an IV curve and the effect of temperature and shading on output
Size inverters and basic balance-of-system components for a given array
Identify safety, standards and maintenance considerations for PV installations

integrative_case: A homeowner wants a rooftop solar quote checked before signing: estimate the realistic annual yield for their roof orientation, confirm the inverter and string sizing make sense, flag shading and temperature effects, and list the safety and maintenance commitments.
